_comment: Single source for every project card on this site: the homepage renders the entries flagged featured, projects/index.html renders all of them, and both read this file at runtime. Fields come from committed captures, not from hand-typed prose - name, summary, install command and links are verbatim from docs/snapshots/alloevil-projects-llms-2026-09-15.txt (the project index's own llms.txt), and tagline_zh is the heading text captured in docs/snapshots/alloevil-projects-2026-09-14.json. Three entries in the index link their own site instead of a repository (agent-changelog, github-discovery, foodmap), so their github link is derived from the name; every links.github is checked to be https://github.com/alloevil/<name> against the repository the name resolves to. claims.json checks the bijection in both directions, so an entry added to the index upstream or a link edited here fails the gate instead of drifting.

groups.label: Evaluation data
groups.blurb: The model × harness matrix leaderboards omit.

groups.label: Research
groups.blurb: Cross-tool studies and ablations, negative results kept.

projects.name: codeblast
projects.tagline_zh: 合并前就知道会坏在哪
projects.summary: Deterministic code graph producing architecture, change and impact maps with `file:line` evidence on every edge; impact recall is verified by mutation testing rather than asserted.

projects.name: paired-eval
projects.tagline_zh: 先跑程序检查，再谈评分
projects.summary: Evaluates models, agents and harnesses with program checks first, rubrics only for the remainder, and paired statistics for the verdict — including what the verdict cannot rule out. Zero dependencies, Python 3.9+.

projects.name: AgentXRay
projects.tagline_zh: 读 agent 真正做了什么
projects.summary: Web dashboard for AI agent session logs across Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, OMP and Gemini CLI, with a per-turn time/token/cost ledger.

projects.name: agent-harness-evals
projects.tagline_zh: 同一个模型，换个 harness 会怎样
projects.summary: The model x agent-harness matrix that model leaderboards omit — one schema over live leaderboard sources.

projects.name: llm-benchmarks-tracker
projects.tagline_zh: 带出处的 benchmark 目录
projects.summary: Sourced, schema-validated catalogue of LLM and agent benchmarks: what each tests, saturation and contamination status, and top scores tagged official / independent / self-reported. Ships a JSON API.

projects.name: AI-Paper-Daily
projects.summary: Automated daily and weekly paper digests for AI agents, RAG and knowledge graphs, aggregated from arXiv and HuggingFace Daily Papers and LLM-filtered.

projects.name: coding-agent-internals
projects.tagline_zh: 12 个 coding agent 是怎么实现的
projects.summary: How coding agents actually implement search, edit, LSP, DAP and sub-agents — shell-fork vs in-process, `str_replace` vs hash-anchored — framed as capability ceilings rather than feature checklists.

projects.name: agents-with-receipts
projects.tagline_zh: 有据可查的 agentic coding 实践
projects.summary: Cell-by-cell verified cross-tool comparison table, a sourced practices map, and an `AGENTS.md` linter.

projects.name: deepresearch-arms-lab
projects.tagline_zh: 14 组消融，负结果照样留着
projects.summary: A 14-arm ablation of deep research pipelines on a weak base model, with negative results retained and re-validation runs.

projects.name: agent-changelog
projects.tagline_zh: 主流 AI Agent 框架版本追踪
projects.summary: Unofficial changelog tracker synced from upstream AI agent framework releases (OpenClaw, Hermes).

projects.name: github-discovery
projects.summary: Finds trending GitHub repositories early from six data sources with scoring and anti-spam, delivered as a daily digest.

projects.name: foodmap
projects.summary: Visualises restaurants recommended by food bloggers on a map, extracting and geocoding venues from posts.

projects.name: weibo-chat-auto
projects.summary: Native desktop app (Tauri + Rust + Node.js) plus a local viewer that archives Weibo group-chat messages, with AI daily summaries and agentic Q&A; self-hosted, data stays local.

projects.name: dsh-xray
projects.summary: Diagnostics for a DeepSeek Harness setup — context-tax attribution, entry inspection, dependency cascades.

projects.name: agent-tool-benchmark
projects.tagline_zh: AI agent 工具的实测基准
projects.summary: Hands-on, reproducible benchmarks of AI agent tooling — same machine, same tasks, scripts published in full.

projects.name: TabCraft
projects.tagline_zh: Chrome 标签页 AI 整理插件
projects.summary: AI-powered Chrome tab organizer that auto-groups by topic, hibernates inactive tabs and removes duplicates, using on-device Gemini Nano; no data leaves the browser.
